text: 双创指数均跌超3%，A股全市场下跌个股超5000只。 恒指半日跌1.5%，恒生科技指数跌近3%，联想集团大跌近14%。 通胀重燃加息预期，亚洲股市重挫，韩国股市跌8%触发熔断，日经225指数跌超5%。 避险需求推动全球债市反弹，美国5年期国债收益率下行10个基点，日本国债收益率亦回落。 铁矿石价格自2024年以来首次跌至每吨90美元下方。 泽连斯基称，乌克兰将恢复打击俄罗斯的炼油厂。 报道：美国正在考虑对伊朗使用“炸弹之母”。
text_en: The dual-innovation indices both fell more than 3%, and more than 5,000 stocks declined across the A-share market. The Hang Seng Index fell 1.5% in the morning session, the Hang Seng Tech Index fell nearly 3%, and Lenovo Group plunged nearly 14%. Renewed inflation stoked rate hike expectations, Asian stocks tumbled, South Korea's stock market fell 8% triggering a circuit breaker, and the Nikkei 225 fell more than 5%. Safe-haven demand drove a rebound in global bond markets, with the US 5-year Treasury yield falling 10 basis points, while Japanese government bond yields also retreated. Iron ore prices fell below $90 per ton for the first time since 2024. Zelensky said Ukraine will resume strikes on Russian oil refineries. Report: The US is considering using the "Mother of All Bombs" on Iran.
